datePolicy: All source entries explicitly record November 6, 2026 Asia/Singapore in the original sources.md. Localization on 2026-11-06 is not source refresh, publication or independent current-law certification. No external re-research performed; rules, fees and future dates remain dated snapshots. Calendar-year mappings of recurring deadlines remain interpretations.
uncertainties: No no-scholarship example fits AUD 120,000. The AUD 118,533 lean Deakin example requires written 25% award, approved 1.5-year duration and suitable living at AUD 550/week; AUD 1,467 headroom is not comfortable. Even standard living with a 25% award exceeds ceiling.

Deakin programme-specific March/July 2027 availability and July Vietnam deadline unverified; Macquarie Vietnam-specific offshore cutoff unverified; La Trobe exact international hard cutoff unverified; RMIT July deadlines TBC. General calendars and late final cutoffs are not visa-ready offshore targets.

IELTS component scores/test validity, degree equivalence, institution/transcript, graduation date, credit outcome, GPA equivalence, scholarship funding and written offer/payment/refund terms remain applicant-specific unknowns. Chinese locale preserves Vietnamese eligibility, not general eligibility for Chinese citizens.

No actual rent, OSHC, flight or health/biometrics/translation quote. Living assumptions are flat over 19/25 months; insurance roughly 22/28 months needs exact visa-period quote. Bond is tied-up refundable cash; advance rent already in living. No wages fund the envelope.

Tuition 5% reserve is a blanket planning uplift, not announced escalation. UTS indicative total already includes estimated increases; RMIT uses stated totals, not annual multiplication. Extra/repeated units or extended study can exceed all allowances.

Visa and policy details are retained November 6 snapshots, not refreshed legal advice. CoE, genuine funds, OSHC and grant work conditions must be checked at lodging. 2027 planning level is not a hard visa cap; scheduled transfer stream and consultation are not treated as already in force.

Planning checkpoints December 15, January 8 and April–May are not official visa deadlines or decision guarantees. Australia Awards 2027 round already closed. No future round deadline invented. Shortened study is not assumed sufficient for subclass 485.

Original Melbourne note repeats generic RMIT interview dates, but final plan/sources explicitly say no Finance selection task; drafts follow that more specific final reconciliation and do not impose an interview deadline.

No application, account, contact, payment, booking, publication, source-run edit or website repository edit. Parent owns inventory, HTML build and full-package checks; author verifies only assigned MD/JSON and review.
editingContract: Local English and Simplified Chinese Markdown, schemaVersion 2 JSON and author-review only. Preserve useful courses, eligibility, full budgets, scholarships, deadlines, visa/policy status and warnings; numeric/date/currency/URL multiplicities and corresponding table cells checked read-only with content_utils. No shared builder/checker/inventory/README modifications, Review/stars or reader directions to unhosted local attachments.
